integrity: The theorem and proofs are supplied in full; exact-rational finite tests are corroboration, not proof of the infinite quantifiers. Priority has not been independently certified.
scientific_limitations: Strictly positive diagonal edge weights and finite loopless simple graphs with at least one edge; pointwise farthest-point statement requires nonnegative center; general quadratic forms not covered. A related separable convex quadratic formulation might predate these observations.
title: Weighted Euclidean distance extrema survive fractional matching relaxation
